about: Feature-flag evaluation vectors shared by the Rust server (micaforge_core::flags), the browser SDK (packages/sdk/src/flag-eval.ts) and the Node SDK (packages/sdk-server/src/flag-eval.ts). Every suite asserts every case. Expectations are computed by the Rust evaluator (regenerate_the_vector_file in apps/backend/crates/core/src/flags.rs) and reviewed by hand. A blake3 case with `len` hashes the bytes i % 251 for i in 0..len.
